estimand: Unconditional contribution of the rank-one checkpoint stratum to canonical F2(p_ref) and its p integral, by orientation and H4-normalized difference; not full F2 or A_top.
selection: Every original counter and original batch; no age/line/H2 cut.
missing_rows: Only rank-one checkpoints are emitted. Missing rows are zero for this rank-one contribution; not classified as rank two.
conditional_replacement: Replace the whole paired vector only if every at-risk orientation is solved within the prefix-only budget. Otherwise keep both original observations.
interpretation: Archive-derived paired hybrid conditional estimator; not independent production, not universal speedup, and not a completed rank-zero/rank-two contribution.
